files.description: The product vocabulary: stage names, board lanes, and the words the product never uses. Reviews should check new copy against it.
The product spec: screens, behaviour, limits and copy. The spec beats the code; a change that contradicts it is a defect.
The Ember design system: colour roles, typography tokens, radii, components, motion and accessibility rules for src/web.
The lint, format, typecheck and test rules and why each exists. A change that needs a suppression should be checked against it.
The application database schema, including encrypted columns, status enums and indexes.
The catalog database schema, kept separate from app.sqlite.
The prices and quotas of the Week and Month plans and the trial.
